notes.title: Patch Notes For New Update 8/23/2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug which caused the slimer in the DLC cave at the beginning of the game to be a mini-boss.


[/list]

Forgive me for this inconvenience! I have no idea how it took this long to notice.
 Please report any other bugs to jaronfund@gmail.com
